description: Cross-model cold-context reviewer subagent profiles for Antigravity CLI, Pi, and Hermes (/verify Tier 7). Pick a reviewer family distinct from the coding session model whenever available.

antigravity.recommendedModelSwitch: Use 'pro' or switch reviewer family opposite the active coder model; pass strictly the 1-sentence goal and git diff.

pi.contextRule: Fresh subagent session with zero authoring transcript; pass strictly the 1-sentence goal and git diff.

hermes.contextRule: Isolated delegate_task call with cold context containing strictly the 1-sentence goal and git diff.

mandatoryCoverageRule: Reviewer must inspect 100% of modified production files in the diff before returning PASS.
